adjudications.reason: This is a legitimate tradeoff. V3's 'all this that was being done' still points to the railroad, Cunard steamers and telegraph listed just before it. 'Universe' carries over from para 3. The irony of the infant who knew only yellow survives. Restoring the 41-word sentence would cost more than the small gain in time order.

evidence.quote: Such things warp young life. The clergyman of the parish, Dr. Lunt, was an unusual pulpit orator
Many a boy might be ruined by much less than the emotions of the funeral service in the Quincy church

adjudications.reason: Directly after the fall 'on the floor of the House', the revision introduces 'The clergyman of the parish' and 'the funeral service' with definite articles but no prior mention of a funeral or its place. The Lunt funeral is essential. The first-draft sentence naming the Quincy church fixes this cheaply.

evidence.quote: in line with that of President Quincy. The Irish gardener once said to the child
It was unusual for boys to sit behind a President grandfather, and to read over his head the tablet in memory of a President great-grandfather

adjudications.reason: The plan treats the pew scene behind Presidents as essential. Without the tablet sentence, the President great-grandfather vanishes from the scene. 'President Quincy' is then the only companion, and V7's premise about Presidents and Churches is thin. Restoring the tablet clause supplies the presidential presence in church.

evidence.quote: but a boy's will is his life, and he dies when it is broken, as the colt dies in harness. Between him and his master has always been war.

adjudications.reason: The paragraph still shows the thorns. A boy's will 'dies when it is broken, as the colt dies in harness', and 'Between him and his master has always been war' leads straight into the school-walk struggle. The siblings sentence is color, not a missing link.

evidence.quote: whether, on the whole, the change of character was morbid or healthy
His character and processes of mind seemed to share in this fining-down process of scale.

adjudications.reason: The paragraph closes on 'the change of character', but the revision cut the hedged sentence that states the fever's effect on character. The plan requires fever as variation and stresses uncertain judgment. One 15-word source sentence restores the physical-to-mental progression and its 'seemed'.

evidence.quote: the only distinctive mark of all the Adamses had been their inherited quarrel with State Street
Supposing he had seen a New York stock-list of 1900

adjudications.reason: The previous paragraph already sets up State Street as the Adams enemy ('their inherited quarrel with State Street'). The stock-list supposition right after 'knowledge' says what that knowledge would be. The syllogism is compressed but still readable, so no edit within budget.
